result: Market rows plus strategies keyed by1.5_t50 and1.75_t65. Every strategy row/latest contains full market fields; no index join needed.

fields.date: Native CL trading-session label YYYY-MM-DD, never inferred weekdays.
fields.price: Raw front-contract close USD/barrel; may jump on rollover.
fields.adjustedClose: Roll-adjusted close bridged to original historical level; use for continuous price chart and T20.
fields.priceQuality: observed / known_gap / unverified; chart should break or explicitly mark known_gap, never interpolate it.
fields.t20: Causal standardized20-session trend; null unknown. Sample standard deviation ddof1.
fields.rank150: Own1.5-chain historical percentile in0..1, null missing.
fields.rank175: Own1.75-chain historical percentile in0..1, null missing.
fields.trigger: true eligible today, false both inputs known but conditions fail, null at least one input missing.
fields.execution: true trigger from2 native sessions earlier executes today; false no execution; null source observation missing. Unknown never resets timer.
fields.remaining: Sessions still planned including today; execution resets20, next session19. remaining1 still holds today; next open exits absent another reset.
fields.holding: Whether frozen research rule currently has a valid long observation period; does not imply actual user position.
fields.entered: First holding session after being flat.
fields.exited: Natural timer expiry only; not a low-dispersion/trend stop.
fields.renewed: True execution while already holding; one position, no pyramiding.
fields.eligibleHistory: False before2021-01-01; earlier rows are historical context only.

offline: oil-bootstrap.json is saved source data with publication verification dates; successful current GET is required to call it freshly read back.
live: Pure GET/read-only sources; browser rebuilds states on new complete-session rows. Do not reuse the source unfiltered timers for either selected strategy.
latest: Final known row is an open-ended state; never force a liquidation there.
